name: CadQuery spacer study
description: Model annular spacers and measure their STEP geometry using a local CadQuery program.

skills.name: CAD spacer experiment
skills.description: Sweep spacer bore diameters, compare solid volumes and retain the exported STEP models.
skills.body: Keep all linear dimensions in millimetres. Delegate model_spacers to an experiment worker using the verified cad-spacer/kernel connection. Join its published receipt. Check the imported STEP volumes against pi * height * (outer_diameter^2 - bore_diameter^2) / 4. Report discrepancies and the actual result artifact.
